artifacts.lane_b_nested_continuation_bug: cumulative_optimizer_steps uses previous_optimizer_steps instead of source cumulative lineage

subject: Joint A/B plan reconciliation after hostile review
body:
ACK/MODIFY Lane B proposal. The surviving joint plan is:

1. Project spine: V7 retention/final-bank qualification remains authoritative. Development training creates candidates only; it never substitutes for the 13,500-case external bank/human/custody gate.

2. GPU serialization: Lane B keeps the GPU until its already-running fixed-shape whole-model timing + one bounded TorchAO8 optimizer-step qualification completes and is reported. Lane A remains queued at the verified 20-step checkpoint. No concurrent heavy CUDA work.

3. Lane A cadence: keep +8-step BNB8/nonpaged continuations as the conservative lineage, but do not use the 16-case sample as the sole indefinite selection signal. New diagnostic policy:
   - fixed 16-case canary after each +8 stage;
   - fixed 64-case confirmatory diagnostic at each +32 cumulative-step milestone, before any backend/optimizer migration, or whenever the 16-case signal weakens/reverses;
   - neither diagnostic is final-bank evidence.

4. Train-window challenge: CPU audit shows rows 0-223 and Lane B 4096-4191 are broadly intermixed across the same major source families, so sequential windows are acceptable for now. Re-audit source-family composition before larger extensions; do not assume this remains true indefinitely.

5. Acceleration disentanglement: do not conflate FLA acceleration and TorchAO optimizer semantics. First prove reference-vs-FLA with the SAME optimizer/start subject/rows. Separately prove BNB8-vs-TorchAO8 with the SAME runtime backend/start subject/rows. Only then attribute speed or quality differences.

6. Fixed-padding gate: padded and unpadded versions of the same microbatch must prove equivalent masks/labels and materially equivalent completion loss/gradients before fixed padding becomes a training default. Faster but semantically shifted is rejected.

7. Backend migration rule: even if Lane B qualifies, Lane A does NOT hot-swap runtime/optimizer mid-lineage. Lane B produces an isolated accelerated candidate. Promotion requires comparable held-out evidence plus receipts; lineage remains explicit.

8. Currentness result: the running Lane B qualification began on fec4dee but probe_v10r2_lane_b_backward.py, train_v10r2_lane_b.py, v10r2_lane_b_runtime.py, and runtime binding V2 have identical Git blob IDs at synchronized remote head b500399. Current GPU evidence is therefore not stale solely because of that merge.

9. REQUIRED LANE B FIX BEFORE NESTED CONTINUATION: train_v10r2_lane_b.py currently computes cumulative_optimizer_steps using resume_check[previous_optimizer_steps], not source cumulative lineage. This is the same under-count defect Lane A fixed. Harmless for first isolated step; blocking for multi-stage Lane B continuation. Fix/test before any nested continuation.

10. Minimalism rule: do not build another abstraction unless it buys one of: measurable end-to-end speed, stronger evidence, lower crash risk, or needed reproducibility.

Hostile disposition:
- Lane B challenge to Lane A's tiny repeated diagnostic: ACCEPTED; diagnostic policy strengthened above.
- Lane A challenge to Lane B microbench-only speed claims: ACCEPTED by both lanes; whole-model gate required.
- Lane A challenge to TorchAO confounding: ACCEPTED; acceleration and optimizer comparisons split.
- Lane B fixed-padding idea: UNRESOLVED pending equivalence + whole-model timing.
- TorchAO8: UNRESOLVED pending the current real optimizer-step result.

After current Lane B gate: publish result + release GPU. If FLA whole-model speedup is weak, abandon fixed padding/FLA as training default. If TorchAO8 fails/OOMs/nonfinite, reject it. Then Lane A takes next GPU turn for rows 160-223 toward step28 under BNB8, followed by the 16-case canary. Lane B stays CPU-side until its next separately justified GPU experiment.
